section.1: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah

1.name_native: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah

hadiths.text: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:"The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'Get me a mat from the mosque.' I said: 'I am menstruating.' He said: 'Your menstruation is not in your hand
